items.label: Pure Tell
items.text: In narration, show and tell should be Pure Tell: Emotions and character traits are reported plainly and explicitly. The narration says what characters feel think, and are.

items.label: Tell-Weighted
items.text: In narration, show and tell should be Tell-Weighted: Emotion and character traits are stated directly. Behavior supplements the statement rather than replacing it; showing is reserved for the scene's strongest beats.

items.label: Balanced
items.text: In narration, show and tell should be Balanced: Emotion and character traits may be named where naming it is efficient, and shown using physical actions.

items.label: Show-Weighted
items.text: In narration, show and tell should be Show-Weighted: Emotion and character traits is conveyed through physical actions by default. Direct statement of emotions and traits appears only where behavior would be ambiguous.

items.label: Pure Show
items.text: In narration, show and tell should be Pure Show: Emotion and character traits is never stated. Both are conveyed through action, physical response, dialogue, and what the character attends to.

items.label: Adaptive Show and Tell
items.text:
In narration, show and tell should be:
- Show by default. Scene-critical emotion — turns, revelations is shown.
- Tell where efficiency matters more than immersion. Minor emotional beats, transitional passages, and background characters are stated plainly.
